description: SessionStart board-context injection (KAIROS-A-0014): emits the repo's .claude/kairos.local.md wiring as additionalContext and instructs the agent to pull live board state via the authenticated kairos MCP tools. Hooks hold no credentials (tokens live with the MCP client); offline degrades to a note. Silent no-op when the repo is not bootstrapped. Stop: the Ralph loop (COLLIERY-T-1861) blocks the stop and gives the next step while a loop of this session is active (state in ~/.claude/kairos-ralph/<session_id>.json); no loop -> silent no-op.
